"""Skill entry point; source location is configured by install_skill.py."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import sys

skill_dir = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
location = skill_dir / "monitor-location.json"
root = (Path(json.loads(location.read_text(encoding="utf-8"))["source"])
        if location.exists() else skill_dir.parents[2])
if not (root / "codex_monitor" / "cli.py").is_file():
    raise SystemExit("codex-monitor source not found; reinstall the skill from the checkout")
sys.path.insert(0, str(root))
from codex_monitor.cli import main

if __name__ == "__main__":
    raise SystemExit(main())
